# Manet.org

> > A comprehensive resource dedicated to the life and works of Édouard Manet, the pioneering French painter who bridged Realism and Impressionism.

This site explores Manet's revolutionary paintings, from his controversial masterpieces like Olympia to his Impressionist works depicting modern Parisian life. Features detailed analysis of his major works, influences from Spanish art and Japanese prints, and his relationships with contemporaries like Monet, Renoir, and Baudelaire.

## Key Topics

- Édouard Manet
- Impressionism
- Paris Salon
- Olympia
- Plein-air painting
- Japanese prints influence
- Baudelaire
- Gennevilliers
- Spanish ballet (Espagnolisme)
- Gustave Courbet
- Claude Monet
- Controversial artwork
- Nude art
- 1860s-1870s French painting
- Seine and Argenteuil

## Masterpiece Paintings

- [Olympia, 1856](https://www.manet.org/olympia.jsp): Manet's controversial 1856 nude masterpiece inspired by Titian
- [Boating, 1874](https://www.manet.org/boating.jsp): Manet's 1874 Impressionist work depicting boating at Gennevilliers
- [Lola de Valence](https://www.manet.org/lola-de-valence.jsp): Spanish ballet dancer portrait with Baudelaire quatrain influence
